claim: For fixed 0<p<1 and the ordinary once-counted triangle T_n in G(n,p), Delta_n(q_n)->0 whenever positive integers q_n=o(sigma_n)=o(n^2).
delta: min(delta_0,1)>0, fixed independently of n and q
family_mechanism: Direct sampling of an integrable characteristic-function envelope by a roots-of-unity filter; distinct from a pointwise-LLT finite-window/Gaussian-mesh implication.
finite_controls: PASS: 67728 exact weighted graph states, eight rational moments/projection variance identities, 320 Fourier cases / 6560 residues. Numerical filter error <=1.066e-14; tolerance 1e-10. Not a certificate for the analytic envelope.
historical_claim: Deduction assembled 2026-10-17 only; no assertion that Gilmer-Kopparty explicitly printed it, no firstness finding, no new deep LLT or mechanism claim.

normalization_and_domain_checks: PASS: actual standard deviation; ordinary count; all signed reduced grid frequencies in [1,pi*sigma_n]; endpoints, even q, q=1, bounded, composite and oscillating q; arbitrary slow subcritical growth; no q-dependent constant.
quantitative_bound: Delta_n(q) <= 2 D zeta(1+delta) (q/(2 pi sigma_n))^(1+delta), for q>=2 and 2 pi sigma_n/q>=1, for sufficiently large n.
